nodes.description: Public monotonic counter of minted token IDs; incremented in mint() and admint().
Public counter of PVP character entries; incremented in addPVP().
Mapping charId => Pvp struct holding uri, price, units and currentUnits.
Owner address inherited from OwnableUpgradeable; governs onlyOwner checks and withdrawAll recipient.
initializer that wires up ERC721, URI storage, pausable, ownable, burnable and UUPS modules.
onlyOwner: creates a new Pvp entry and increments _charId.
payable: requires msg.value >= price, mints a token to msg.sender and increments currentUnits.
onlyOwner: mints a token to recipient from a Pvp entry and increments currentUnits.
Sends the entire contract balance to owner() via a low-level send.
onlyOwner: pauses token transfers.
onlyOwner: unpauses token transfers.
whenNotPaused hook invoked on every transfer, mint and burn.
onlyOwner: access control gate for UUPS implementation upgrades.
Returns the metadata URI for a given token id.
Burns a token and clears its URI storage entry.
Caller-controlled address; mint recipient and subject of all onlyOwner checks.
Low-level send of the full contract balance to the owner address.
ERC721 onERC721Received callback executed on the recipient during _safeMint.
mint() argument selecting the Pvp entry to purchase.
addPVP() argument holding the token URI string.
addPVP() argument holding the required mint price.
addPVP() argument holding the total supply of units.
admint() argument selecting the Pvp entry to mint from.
admint() argument naming the mint recipient.
Memory cache of pvps[charId] inside mint().
Memory cache of pvps[charId] inside admint().
Newly constructed Pvp struct inside addPVP().
Contract balance read into a local inside withdrawAll().

edges.reason: charId parameter is read by mint() to index the pvps mapping.
_uri parameter is stored into the new Pvp entry by addPVP().
_price parameter is stored into the new Pvp entry by addPVP().
_units parameter is stored into the new Pvp entry by addPVP().
charId parameter indexes pvps inside admint().
recipient parameter becomes the _safeMint destination in admint().
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient and pays msg.value.
msg.sender is the caller that must satisfy the onlyOwner gate of admint().
msg.sender is compared against owner() by the onlyOwner modifier of _authorizeUpgrade.
msg.sender must equal owner() to call pause().
msg.sender must equal owner() to call unpause().
msg.sender must equal owner() to call addPVP().
_owner is the recipient of the balance transferred by withdrawAll().
withdrawAll routes the contract balance into the low-level send operation.
mint() increments pvps[charId].currentUnits only after the _safeMint external call returns.
admint() increments pvps[charId].currentUnits only after the _safeMint external call returns.
addPVP() writes the new Pvp struct into the pvps mapping.
addPVP() increments the _charId counter.
mint() increments _tokenId before minting.
admint() increments _tokenId before minting.
mint() copies pvps[charId] into the local pvp variable.
admint() copies pvps[charId] into the local pvp variable.
addPVP() assembles the newPVP struct before storing it.
withdrawAll() reads address(this).balance into the amount local.
The amount local is the value passed to the unsafe send in withdrawAll().
mint() calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on msg.sender before currentUnits is updated.
admint() calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on recipient before currentUnits is updated.
withdrawAll() transfers control to the owner address through the low-level send.
mint() triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer whenNotPaused hook.
admint() triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer whenNotPaused hook.
The ERC721 receiver callback lets the minter re-enter mint() before pvps[charId].currentUnits is incremented.
The ERC721 receiver callback lets the recipient re-enter admint() before pvps[charId].currentUnits is incremented.
The owner address regains control during send and could re-enter withdrawAll() or mint().

normalization_plan.reason: charId is used only to index pvps inside mint(), so it merges into that core function node.
_uri is consumed only by addPVP() when building the Pvp entry, so it merges into that function.
_price is consumed only by addPVP() when building the Pvp entry, so it merges into that function.
_units is consumed only by addPVP() when building the Pvp entry, so it merges into that function.
charId is used only to index pvps inside admint(), so it merges into that core function node.
recipient is used only as the _safeMint destination inside admint(), so it merges into that function.
The pvp local exists only inside mint() and carries no independent semantics.
The pvp local exists only inside admint() and carries no independent semantics.
newPVP is a transient struct built and stored exclusively inside addPVP().
amount is the balance value fed directly into the unsafe send operation of withdrawAll().
